🌮 Some Texas traditions are worth keeping.

In San Antonio, Sunday morning means barbacoa tacos, warm tortillas, fresh salsa, and an ice-cold Big Red for a whole lot of families.

The barbacoa tradition goes back generations. Big Red came along later, and together they became one of San Antonio's most recognizable weekend rituals.

Did your family grow up with barbacoa and Big Red? Or what's the Sunday tradition at your house?

Read the story behind this Texas favorite:
https://texasdefined.com/barbacoa-big-red-san-antonio
